name: BACH_0400
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests InSitu (90%)** · Unreliable input · Careful review
Flagged (tier 3) for low reliability (48%), backbone disagreement, and a 72%-risk region despite 5% invasive risk.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Top probabilities | InSitu 90%, Benign 5%, Invasive 5%, Normal 0% [F1] | Low overall invasive risk (5%) |
| Conformal set | {InSitu} (alpha 10%; 90% test coverage, n=132) | Single class at dataset guarantee |
| Reliability / OOD | 48% (0.475, flagged); OOD 76th percentile [F6] | Suspect input; recut/levels orders drafted |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Disagree on top class (false) | Independent foundation models disagree |
| Similar cases | 3/5 (60%) InSitu; 1 Invasive, 1 Benign [F5] | Mixed; invasive contrast case BACH_0138 |

## Tissue evidence
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (region 8) · ↑ invasive · Below-typical score (-0.51) pushes read toward invasive (+0.66) [F2] · Validated
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (region 8) · ↑ invasive · Below-typical score (-0.05) pushes toward invasive (+0.57); 0/20 spot-check [F3] · Unreliable
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 8) · ↓ invasive · Below-typical score (-0.03) pushes away from invasive (-0.56) [F4] · Validated
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (regions 2, 7) · ↓ invasive · High score (+1.12) favors in situ (-0.19); 12/20 spot-check · Weak
- **Tumor cell fraction and density** (regions 2, 10, 11) · context · 92% neoplastic nuclei (100th percentile) [F7]; 4,271/mm² (97th percentile) [F8] · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful to classifier; removing top-3 risk regions drops invasive probability above random (0.0114, 95% CI 0.0021 to 0.0197, n=132).
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (0.0008, 95% CI -0.0088 to 0.0064); leans on unreliable normal-lobules (0/20), mitoses (0/20), and necrosis (3/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Focal stromal invasion exists in high-risk region 10 (72% risk), matching invasive contrast neighbor BACH_0138 (87% similarity).
- Low input reliability (48%, 76th-percentile OOD) distorts features; CONCH and MUSK disagree on the top class.

## Check on the slide
1. **Region 10 (and 11)**: Inspect for focal stromal invasion; region 10 carries 72% invasive risk (region 11: 10%).
2. **Regions 2, 7, 10, 11**: Verify duct confinement and 90th-percentile nuclear shape variation [F9]; review drafted ER stain.
3. **Region 8**: Check stroma and lobules for quality artifacts; consider drafted recut H&E and deeper levels.
